topics.label: Introduction to the lecture on complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic frames the lecture by introducing complement and setting expectations for the session.

topics.label: Foundational principles and architecture of the complement cascade
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics introduce the core architecture, nomenclature, and central C3-dependent operating principles of the complement system.

topics.label: Mechanisms of complement activation pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how different upstream recognition pathways converge to deposit active C3 on target surfaces.

topics.label: Effector mechanisms of complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the downstream effector mechanisms triggered by complement to destroy or clear pathogens.

topics.label: Regulation of complement on host cells
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the regulatory mechanisms and proteins that protect host cells from unintended complement attack.

topics.label: Clinical consequences of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the distinct clinical presentations and disease phenotypes that result from specific complement deficiencies.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores how pathogens have evolved mechanisms to circumvent and neutralize host complement defenses.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture, wrapping up the topic and previewing the next session.
